sourceTitle: Allowances (Foster with Slough, Slough Children First)

fees.label: Tier 3 (three or more years as a carer)

feesNote: On top of the child's allowance, Slough pays a weekly level-of-care payment in three tiers that rise with the carer's skills, experience and training, plus a supplementary fee when a child has more complex needs; the page does not say whether the tier payment is per child or per household.
extras: A birthday allowance and a festival allowance each year for each child (the page gives no amounts)
Two weeks of holiday payment a year, taken when no child is placed
A £200 thank-you payment after each successful annual review
summary: Slough Children First, which runs fostering for Slough, says these rates apply from 1 April 2026. Carers receive a weekly allowance for each child in five age bands, plus a weekly payment by tier and a supplementary fee for children with more complex needs. Tier progression is discussed during assessment.
